title: Narmer Palette shows Egypt existed before reunification

tellings.quote: because the hallmark of the beginning of the dynastic period is known as the reunification of upper and lower Egypt as indicated by the Nar pallet or the meanis pallet.

plain: The Narmer Palette, an ancient carved Egyptian slab, is said to mark the start of Egypt's age of kings by showing the reunification of Upper and Lower Egypt, which implies an Egypt existed before that joining. A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm makes this point in his own summary, without naming a source, calling the reunification "the hallmark of the beginning of the dynastic period" as shown on the palette. He raises it to argue that Egyptian civilization is older than the usual starting point.
